Completion of delisting of Abu Dhabi National Energy Company PJSC from Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange

Abu Dhabi National Energy Company PJSC ("TAQA" or the "Company") hereby notifies the London Stock Exchange plc that the shares of the Company have been delisted from the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange with effect from 1 September 2026.
